title: Artificial Intelligence and Predictive Data Analytics to Enhance Risk Assessment and Credit Scoring Mechanisms in Retail Banking
tldr: A variational autoencoder with spatio-temporal attention mechanism generates dynamic, uncertainty-aware credit scores that adapt to borrower behavior in real time.
problem_and_motivation: Traditional credit scoring models rely on linear heuristics that fail to capture complex nonlinear interactions among borrower factors. The opacity of high-performing ML models creates tension between predictive accuracy and regulatory compliance requirements for transparency. Existing approaches struggle to integrate heterogeneous data sources and provide real-time adaptive creditworthiness assessments.
approach: Modular Bayesian framework decomposes the prediction function into specialized modules for different data modalities, combined through a learned gating network.
Variational autoencoder (VAE) with multi-head attention mechanisms learns dynamic credit representations from sequential borrower data.
Probabilistic inference enables uncertainty quantification in credit predictions using posterior predictive distributions.
Two-stage feature selection: mutual information filtering followed by regularized gradient-boosted tree wrapper optimization.
Custom weighted loss function balances type I and type II error costs under regulatory capital constraints.
Model validated through time-aware splits, AUC-ROC, Precision-Recall AUC, Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics, and Brier scores.
Stress testing performed by perturbing input features according to macroeconomic shock scenarios.
findings: Proposed VAE-attention model achieves dynamic credit scores that adapt instantaneously to new borrower data.
Modular gating network enables dynamic leveraging of most informative data modules as borrower behavior evolves.
Bayesian uncertainty quantification provides principled risk estimates for regulatory compliance.
Feature engineering pipeline with monotonic splines and learned embeddings handles high-cardinality categorical variables.
Stress testing via Jacobian norm analysis identifies brittle dependencies under macroeconomic shocks.
Microservice architecture with CI/CD pipelines enables production deployment within banking infrastructure.

definitions.definition: Variational Autoencoder, a generative model that learns latent representations through probabilistic inference.
Evidence Lower Bound, an objective function optimized in variational inference to approximate the marginal likelihood.
Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve, measuring model's discrimination ability between classes.
SHapley Additive exPlanations, a game-theoretic approach to explain individual predictions.
Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations, a method for explaining individual predictions of any model.
Conditional Value at Risk, a tail-risk measure quantifying expected loss beyond a confidence threshold.
Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic, a non-parametric test measuring separation between default and non-default distributions.
A proper scoring rule measuring accuracy of probabilistic predictions.
Magnitude of partial derivatives quantifying model sensitivity to input perturbations.
A metric monitoring distributional drift in feature values over time.
